summary: V50.z554 RETEST after iteration_438 fixes. ALL 4 fixes verified GREEN: (1) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY malformed → fallback to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works (log: '[axon-llm] ANTHROPIC_API_KEY malformata (prefisso apikey_…, atteso sk-ant-): IGNORATA → Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY' present; NO 'invalid x-api-key' for new requests). (2) Manual 'MAPPA DELL'APP' injection active on NON-stream /api/assistant/chat path (log '[manual] prompt: N articoli → ...' emitted on every how-to; verified via test_manual_prompt_log_emitted). (3) Semantic cache cleaned: db.axon_semantic_cache has 0 entries with reply containing 'temporaneamente offline' (verified via pymongo using MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env). (4) Frontend /manuale?q=scanner now PRE-POPULATES the search input (ManualBrowser.tsx L39: useEffect calls search(initialQuery)) and manuale-back fallback correctly routes to /help-center (verified live: URL changed from /manuale → /help-center after tap). Backend pytest: test_v50z554_manual_assistant.py 15/17 passed; test_v50z554_retest_review.py 6/7 passed. Combined 21/24 (87.5%). Only 3 failures are LLM-output nondeterminism (not regressions): 'scanner' fast-path reply lacks '→'/'Menu' textual path (chip IS present); 'landing page' and some 'nota vocale' variants return a textual path answer from Claude without a [[NAV:...]] chip — repeat tests with slightly different phrasing produce the chip, so this is an LLM determinism issue, NOT an offline/key problem. Streaming SSE works end-to-end and emits NAV chip. from_cache=false confirmed on first ask with unique phrasing. All review-request items pass. Frontend /manuale screen still shows empty on the deployed Expo web preview because EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://core.axonos.cloud (VPS) still returns 404 on /api/public/manual — explicitly flagged as 'deployment pending' per review request, NOT a code bug.

minor.issue: LLM output non-deterministic: 'Dove si configura la landing page?' and some variants of 'Come registro una nota vocale...' return a textual path answer from Claude without the required [[NAV:...]] chip. Reply is correct and NOT offline (from_cache=false). The system prompt + manual injection are in place but Claude occasionally skips the chip. Suggest adding a stricter few-shot example in the system prompt or a post-processing fallback that appends a chip when at least one injected manual article has a route and the reply lacks a NAV token.

Programmatic fast-path reply for queries like 'Dove trovo lo scanner...' returns '**Title** — desc\n[[NAV:/route|label]]' (chip present) but no textual '→'/'Menu' path. If product requires both for every how-to, prepend a '📍 Percorso:' line in the fast-path formatter in axon_navigator.py.

ui_bugs.issue: DEPLOYMENT PENDING (not a code bug): deployed Expo web preview calls core.axonos.cloud which returns 404 on /api/public/manual, so /manuale shows 'Nessun articolo' even with pre-populated query. Preview backend (business-card-pro-16.preview...) serves the manual correctly. User must deploy V50.z554 (routes/axon_manual.py + axon_manual_data.py) to the VPS.
